title: On the Erdős--Odlyzko--Sárközy conjecture for prime-power moduli
summary: Erdős, Odlyzko and Sárközy conjectured that every reduced residue class modulo $q$ contains a product of two primes not exceeding $q$. O. Klurman, A. P. Mangerel and J. Teräväinen (2023) have shown that three primes suffice when $q$ is sufficiently smooth. We study the moduli $q=p^γ$ that are powers of a fixed prime $p$ and we show that the third prime can be taken subpolynomially small. For any $q_\bullet\le q$ for which $q_\bullet\ge\exp\bigl(C(\log q)^{2/3}(\log\log q)^{4/3}\bigr)$, we give an asymptotic formula for the weighted number of representations of each reduced class as a product…
